name: summary
description: One or two sentences stating what this record is and why it exists.

aiGuidance.purpose: The abstract a reader gets before deciding to open the body. One or two sentences that state the substance — what this is, and what turns on it — so a tree of these records can be read end to end without expanding anything.
aiGuidance.extraction: Write the claim, not the topic: prefer "The spec's layering is invisible to a reader who arrives at a single record" over "About layering". Two sentences maximum; if a third is needed the material belongs in body. Never restate the title in other words.
